scope_note: Only retrieved primary material is used as external support. Design choices and thresholds are proposed. This is not a full systematic literature review or an on-server model validation.

sources.title: Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction
sources.supported_use: One-direction interventions mediate measured refusal across studied models; does not guarantee semantic purity or no collateral damage.

sources.title: The Geometry of Refusal in Large Language Models: Concept Cones and Representational Independence
sources.supported_use: Multiple independent directions; geometric orthogonality alone does not imply intervention independence.

sources.title: A Unified Mechanistic Analysis of Knowledge- and Safety-Based Refusals
sources.supported_use: KR/SR overlap and asymmetry on 213 quadruples; full extraction/numerical details require separate version audit.

sources.title: Dual-Direction Mechanistic Interpretability: author repository
sources.supported_use: DIM pipeline; README lists AdvBench/Alpaca and SQuAD-v2/TriviaQA, 4-bit examples. This turn did not inspect every source file.

sources.title: How Alignment Routes: Localizing, Scaling, and Controlling Policy Circuits in Language Models
sources.supported_use: Intermediate gate and amplifier motif; low DLA need not imply low causal contribution; no direct universal epistemic/tool-circuit guarantee.

sources.title: How to use and interpret activation patching
sources.supported_use: Methodological anchor for protocol- and metric-dependent interpretation. Specific experimental design in this plan is proposed, not copied evidence.

sources.title: Surgical Refusal Ablation: Disentangling Safety from Intelligence via Concept-Guided Spectral Cleaning
sources.supported_use: Section 3.2 lists epistemic uncertainty among Targets. Ridge on Shields+Confounds is not an established guarantee of decision preservation.

sources.title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
sources.supported_use: Paired should-act/should-abstain evaluation and sandbox scenarios; this plan adapts design, does not claim official benchmark results.

sources.title: NVIDIA CUDA Programming Guide: CUDA Environment Variables
sources.supported_use: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES limits and reorders visible devices; UUIDs supported.

sources.title: PyTorch set_per_process_memory_fraction
sources.supported_use: Caching allocator limit is total visible memory times fraction; not free-memory fraction or a hard whole-process isolation guarantee.

sources.title: Official MiniCPM5-2B repository file list
sources.supported_use: Listing shows approximately 5.03 GB safetensors. Raw config and model-card fetch failed this turn; 42-layer/2048 budget dimensions are from prior report and require on-host pinned verification.

sources.title: OpenBMB MiniCPM official repository
sources.version: main as returned; page still focused on 1B
sources.supported_use: Returned 1B documentation describes standard Llama, thinking toggle, XML tools and SFT/RL/OPD. Not treated as exact 2B config/template verification.

sources.title: LLMs Encode Harmfulness and Refusal Separately
sources.supported_use: Harmfulness and refusal can be causally dissociated in studied settings; not proof of preserved epistemic uncertainty after every edit.

sources.title: Abliteration Is Not a Scalpel
sources.supported_use: Behavioral side effects and provenance contamination risks. Not a circuit localization or universal no-capability-loss result.
